title: Accept a 60 s source/committed-input budget: raise the source budget maximum and the CLI range to 60000 ms
outcome: Accept a 60 s source/committed-input budget: raise the source budget maximum and the CLI range to 60000 ms
acceptance: `engram source --timeout-ms` accepts 60000; the default is 60000; a requested public value below 60000 is raised to 60000, never refused and never shortening the abort; values above the maximum still refuse.

A behavioural test shows a 60000 ms request is accepted and honoured as one absolute budget, that a 30000 ms public override is raised to one 60000 ms absolute deadline, that `--timeout-ms 1` yields a clean observation rather than a deadline refusal, and that values above the maximum still refuse

completion.summary: Verified the 60 s source/committed-input budget on master, where aacb1370 delivered it: MAX_BUDGET_MS = MIN_PUBLIC_BUDGET_MS = 60_000; `engram source --timeout-ms` defaults to 60000, takes 1..=60000, and raises a shorter public request to one 60 s deadline. Central runs at 5bcd10b8: committed_input a_ tests 2/2 (test-e48e6cea); source-input.test.mjs 56/56 (test-90aaab8b) after building the debug binary (test-f4f5d375). An independent Codex evaluator (session-19633) passed both criteria.
